notes: Sequential controlled scenes, not a replay of the user save. Single captures, not confidence intervals.
Physical capture uses CSS viewport 2048x1152 at DPR 1.25, yielding a 2560x1440 canvas. Oversized prototype experiments used 3200x1800.
Displayed intervals come from PresentMon on the game GPU process principal swap chain. RAF callback and CPU timings are separate.
Position is pinned for pen and nightpond; drive moves continuously. Water and slime dynamics can vary between runs.
Ranked CPU groups combine exclusive simulation/render groups. Nested buckets are not added to their parents. These are submission and stall times, not hardware GPU cost.

visual.note: Contour differences stay within one 8-bit level, interior texture resampling within five. Larger differences are confined to the outermost viewport border during fractional camera shake.
